description: This file implements an image generation service class 'FalImageGenService' that integrates with Fal.ai's API to generate images from text prompts. It includes configuration parameters, HTTP request handling, and image processing logic.

classes.name: FalImageGenService
classes.description: A service class for generating images via Fal.ai's API, with configurable parameters and asynchronous image retrieval.

classes.name: FalImageGenService.InputParams
classes.description: A Pydantic model class defining input parameters for image generation such as seed, inference steps, image size, safety checker, and format.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FalImageGenService with parameters, HTTP session, model name, and optional API key.

methods.name: run_image_gen
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an image from a text prompt, yielding either a URLImageRawFrame with image data or an ErrorFrame if generation fails.
